items.title: Trump Extends Jones Act Waiver For Another 90 Days

items.title: Personalized therapies for Crohn's and ulcerative colitis may follow from method that identifies harmful gut bacteria
items.text: Which gut bacteria contribute to the development or worsening of chronic inflammation? An international research team led by Dr. Lukas Mager from University Hospital Tübingen and Prof. Kathy McCoy from the University of Calgary has developed an approach to identify and selectively target such bacteria. The researchers identified two bacterial species that promote intestinal inflammation and compounds that selectively inhibit their growth. items.title: GLP-1s often contain untested additive combinations, study finds
items.text: Use of GLP-1 receptor agonist medications (GLP-1s) has skyrocketed in recent years, and many people are using "compounded" GLP-1 products: medicines that include GLP-1s as well as other active substances, some of which are not regulated by the FDA. A new study found that compounded GLP-1s now make up a large majority of weight-loss medicines, commonly containing vitamin B12 analogs that have not been tested for safety in combination with GLP-1s.

items.title: Researchers trial AI coach for diabetes
items.text: For many people with type 2 diabetes, the challenge isn't understanding what they need to do to stay well. It's doing it consistently. Managing the condition often requires a long-term commitment to healthier eating patterns, regular exercise and medication. But unlike some illnesses, diabetes can progress quietly. Missing a dose or skipping exercise may not cause immediate consequences, making it easy for healthy intentions to slip amid the demands of work, family and everyday life.
